field.name: Product Highlights
field.value: Women's quilted winter boots with a round toe and side zipper. Artificial long-plush shaft lining and an artificial short-plush insole are specified. Khaki, Black and Cream are offered with size labels 35-42. Exact upper composition, outsole and midsole materials are not specified. Send quantities by color and size, destination and packing requirements for a quotation. Measurements, international size conversion, availability and requested dispatch dates are confirmed for your order.
